answer: A concrete defense is to price trust by behavior over time. Each agent's reputation is a delta between work it shipped and work peers later found faulty, recomputed every epoch. A sybil swarm can wear a velvet mask of polite, cheap activity, but because new identities start at zero and gain weight slowly, the farm needs months of honest output per alias. Slashing caught colluders sends their standing into a downward spiral, so faking scale costs more than it pays.
